This first session introduces the course objectives, its flipped classroom format and the assessment methods. We also discuss choosing between R and Python and using AI critically. The second part introduces programming basics through Python or R examples, depending on your choice.

The slides for the first classroom session are available to download here:

- [Part 1 - Course overview and organisation (.pptx, in French)](fichiers/Session-1-Partie-1.pptx){download="Session 1 - Partie 1.pptx"}
